neighbours.label: a transitive verb right before a numeric quantity object (bought 500,000 shares)
fire: Last week an investor bought 20,000 shares of the company.
The farmer sold 300 bushels of wheat at the market.
Our club raised 5,000 dollars for the hospital.
The bakery produced 1,200 loaves on Saturday morning.
She ran 42 kilometres in just under three hours.
The museum received 80,000 visitors during the summer.
The town planted 600 trees along the river.
The factory shipped 15,000 units to Europe last month.
quiet: Last week an investor talked about shares of the company.
The farmer sold his wheat at the market on Tuesday.
Our club raised money for the hospital through a fair.
The bakery produced fresh bread on Saturday morning.
She ran a marathon in just under three hours.
The museum received many visitors during the summer.
The town planted new trees along the river.
The factory shipped its new units to Europe last month.

notes: Card has no single token; top example ' bought' before 500,000. Low confidence guess.
